loginNotConfigured.title: Interactive login is not configured
loginNotConfigured.body: Set Dupli__Auth__Mode=EntraId and the Entra ID settings on the server to use the web UI. The admin API is still available with the X-Dupli-Admin-Key header.

AgentOffline.label: Agent offline
AgentOffline.description: An agent has not sent a heartbeat for a while.

BackupFailed.label: Backup failed
BackupFailed.description: A backup job failed or timed out.

BackupMissed.label: Backup missed
BackupMissed.description: A scheduled backup did not run.

BackupTooOld.label: Backup too old
BackupTooOld.description: A policy has had no successful backup for too long.

AgentUpdateFailed.label: Agent update failed
AgentUpdateFailed.description: An agent update was rolled back.

AgentOutdated.label: Agent outdated
AgentOutdated.description: An agent has been stuck off the desired version for a while.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Alert opens and resolutions you are subscribed to.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Who may sign in. Viewer reads only; Operator runs backups, browses snapshots and restores; Owner also manages users, storage targets and releases.

notificationSettings.title: Notification settings
notificationSettings.subtitle: Choose e-mail and/or in-app for each alert type. Unset types default to in-app for everyone, and mail for Owner and Operator.

accessDenied.title: Access denied
accessDenied.thisAccountNotEnabled: This account is not enabled in Dupli.
accessDenied.askOwner: Ask an owner to invite you, then sign in again.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.subtitle: Evaluated every minute. Notifications are sent by e-mail when an alert opens and when it resolves.

logs.title: Agent logs
logs.subtitle: Information and above, uploaded by the agents in batches.

admin.title: Break-glass user management
admin.subtitle: Admin key access for when no owner can sign in. The session lasts 15 minutes and only manages users.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.body: Set Dupli__Admin__ApiKey on the server and restart it to use this page. Remove it again afterwards.

storage.title: Storage targets
storage.subtitle: S3 endpoint + bucket shared by agents. Each agent writes under its own prefix with its own key.

form.name: Name
form.versioningHint: Enable bucket versioning and a lifecycle rule for noncurrent versions on the provider side.

agents.title: Agents
agents.subtitle: One agent per Host, each with its own restic repository.

form.name: Name
form.storagePrefixHint: Path inside the bucket; the S3 key should be restricted to it.
form.repositoryPasswordHint: Optional: only to adopt an existing repository. Generated otherwise.
form.secretsNotice: Secrets are stored encrypted on the server and delivered to the agent at enrollment.

releases.title: Releases
releases.subtitle: Agent and restic versions mirrored by the server and distributed via the heartbeat.

importForm.title: Import from GitHub
importForm.description: Registers the agent releases found on the v<version> tag of the configured repository (one per available platform).

confirmMakeCurrent.title: Make {{version}} ({{platform}}) current?
confirmMakeCurrent.messageBase: It will become the desired version for agents on this platform.
confirmMakeCurrent.messageWithChannel: It will become the desired version for agents on this platform and channel {{channel}}.

general.title: General
general.storageTargetHint: Per agent: every policy of this agent goes to the same repository.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.cronHint: 5 fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week. E.g. 0 2 * * * = every day at 02:00.

retention.title: Retention
retention.hint: Applied by the weekly retention job (restic forget --keep-daily/weekly/monthly, then prune).

sources.title: Sources
sources.sourceIdHint: Stable key used in the restic source= tag. Changing it starts a new snapshot history.
sources.excludesHint: One restic exclude pattern per line (optional)

postgres.noConnectionsPrefix: This agent has no PostgreSQL connections yet. Add one in its
postgres.connectionHintPrefix: Host, port, username and password secret come from the agent's
postgres.excludeHint: Excluded, one per line. Templates and postgres are always skipped.
postgres.includeHint: Backed up, one per line (postgres allowed). A database missing on the server fails the backup.

confirmDelete.title: Delete policy?
confirmDelete.message: The policy and its run history are deleted. Existing snapshots stay in the repository until retention removes them.

RestartAgent.label: Restart agent
RestartAgent.confirm: The agent service will restart as soon as it picks up the request (within 15 minutes).

RestoreTest.label: Run restore test
RestoreTest.confirm: Restores a sample of files and the latest database dumps into a temporary directory and verifies them.

Retention.label: Run retention
Retention.confirm: Applies the retention rules of every policy (restic forget + prune). Old snapshots are removed.

RepositoryCheck.label: Check repository
RepositoryCheck.confirm: Runs restic check reading a subset of the data.

enrollmentToken.title: Enrollment token
enrollmentToken.shownOnce: Shown only once. Valid until {{expires}}, single use. Run on the VM as Administrator:

deleteForm.hint: Removes {{name}} and all its policies, jobs, history, logs, alerts, connections and notifications. The repository in the bucket is not deleted from the storage provider.

credentialsForm.skipVerification: Skip verification (do not try to list the repository with the new key first)
credentialsForm.revokeHint: Revoke the old key with the storage provider only once the status above reads "{{status}}".

status.tooOldForCredentials: Agent too old for automatic credential updates
status.waitingForAgent: Waiting for the agent to apply them

policiesTab.title: Backup policies
policiesTab.empty: No policies. Nothing is backed up for this agent yet.

connectionsTab.binDirectoryHint: Optional. Auto-detected from the registry when empty.
connectionsTab.passwordHintEditing: Write-only: leave empty to keep the current password.
connectionsTab.passwordHintNew: Write-only: never shown again once saved.
connectionsTab.empty: No PostgreSQL connections. Add one, then reference it from a policy source.

restoreTestsTab.empty: No restore test yet. They run weekly, or use "Run restore test".

toasts.clipboardUnavailable: Clipboard not available: select the text and copy it manually
toasts.nothingToRun: Nothing to run: every policy already has a pending job

confirms.disableAgentBody: The agent can no longer authenticate and no job is scheduled for it. Re-enabling requires a new enrollment token.
confirms.enableAgentBody: The agent goes back to Pending: generate a new enrollment token and run the install command on the VM again.
confirms.deleteConnectionBody: Fails if a policy source still uses it for PostgreSQL backups.

invite.title: Invite
invite.emailHint: Entra ID email or UPN. Bound to the account on first sign-in.
invite.noEmailSent: No email is sent: tell the person to open Dupli and sign in with that account.

confirmDisable.title: Disable user
confirmDisable.message: {{email}} loses access immediately, including open sessions.

confirmDelete.title: Delete user
confirmDelete.boundMessage: {{email}} has already signed in. Deleting it removes the account binding; disabling keeps it.
confirmDelete.invitationMessage: The invitation for {{email}} will be removed.

form.targetDirectoryHint: Must be new or empty and outside every backed-up path. Production data is never overwritten.
form.alsoLoadDump: Also load the dump into a new database (pg_restore)
form.newDatabaseHint: Created on {{connection}}; the restore fails if it already exists.
form.confirmNameLabel: Type the name again to confirm

confirmRestore.message: Restores {{what}} of {{shortId}} to {{where}} on the VM.
confirmRestore.andDatabase: Then creates database "{{newDatabase}}" and loads the dump into it.
confirmRestore.title: Restore?

snapshotBrowser.restoreQueued: Restore queued: the agent picks it up at its next poll
